latent_variables.name: Individual sensitivity differences
latent_variables.rationale: High heterogeneity (high) across findings suggests an unmeasured individual-difference variable moderates the effect of absorption balcony ceiling weighted on acoustic quality.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Pre-screening for trait sensitivity or prior exposure

latent_variables.rationale: Individual/cultural differences theory is implicated. Cultural norms around nature, noise, or space may moderate effects.

latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Design Principles, Individual/Cultural Differences). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of absorption balcony ceiling weighted, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.

research_needs.question: Does the effect of absorption balcony ceiling weighted on acoustic quality replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is low. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains absorption balcony ceiling weighted → acoustic quality?
